items.text: Oko nakwo ogosesenia Musa, omonto o Nyasae, asesenetie Abaisraeli ekero konya atarakwa.
akabara buna risase korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani;
agacha ore amo n’abachenu chilifu ikomi,
ogochika kore buna chinsase chi’omorero gokabaachera
Amaene, nigo anchete abanto b’ebisaku bionsi;
abachenu baye bonsi nigo bare ase oborendi bw’okoboko kwaye.
Barabwo nigo baikaraansete inse ase amagoro yo Omonene,
ayio are omwando bw’omosangererekano bw’ abanto ba Yakobo.
“Tiga Abareubeni bagenderere koba moyo, tibaabaisa gokwa,
obairanie naende babe amo n’abanto bamwabo.
Barabwo nigo bakwanete igoro y’abaise na abaang’ina,
gose tibaabarete abana babo ng’a ’mbare nengeencho ase bare,
bakabwata okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwakorete na barabwo.
Omonene, obasesenie amo nebi bionsi babwate,
obune chibachwa chi’ababisa baabo baria bagoocha kobarwania,
abae obotooru na ebinto ebiya bire ase riroba ime,
Asesenie ebigoro bia kare bitubwe n’obonge bw’okwama okuya,
n’ebitunwa bireo botambe, birue okwama okonge boigo.
Abae ebinto ebiya korwa ase riroba, na ebiichire ime yaye,
amo n’ogwancherwa gokorwa ase are ere oyobweorokereretie ase egetutu keria.
Omotangi oye nigo are n’obonene bw’echinguru buna chieeri,
ne ching’unchara chiaye nigo chire buna echi’eng’era,
ase chirochio naseerie abanto goikera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.
naende echio nachio chilifu chinyinge chi’Abamanase.”
nainwe Abaisakaru, mogooke ase chiema chiaino ime.
Barabwo ’mbarangerie abanto b’ebisaku bachiche ase egetunwa kiabo,
ekiagera nigo bakonyora obotenenku bwabo korwa ase chinyancha ase
Abagadi nigo barabe bakoramama inse buna endo,
ekiagera agwo nao egetari ki’omogaambi kiagachetwe.
na konacha ebiina bi’ekeene ase Abaisraeli.”
na ogosesenigwa kw’ogoisaneka korwa ase Omonene,
moire orogongo rore ase enyancha ensemo ya Irianyi,”
amagoro abo atache riroba rikomera amazeituni.
Emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino ebe ey’ebioma ne chitaai,
onde tari ore buna Nyasae oo,
oria ogoeta igoro gati ase obonene bwaye
Nyasae o kare na kare nere ore obotamero bwaino;
Inse aa nao amaboko aye a kare na kare are kogaamba.
Naseerie ababisa baino korwa ase more,
Ase ayio Abaisraeli nigo baramenye batari n’obwoba,
na ororeeria rorwete ase Yakobo nigo roramenye ase obotoereru,
nainwe motaare goetera ase ebigoro biabo.”
